note: A Python orchestration protocol; not an implementation of learn, run or free. The run phase is a bounded native program-run transport whose .adva output is recorded as bytes, never interpreted. Pascal documents remain independent proposed inputs.

phases.name: run
phases.meaning: Each slot makes one bounded native program run; the .adva output is recorded as bytes without schema or semantic interpretation. The subject is a byte copy of programs/native-run/arithmetic.adva pinned into the library directory. Six report slots are not six executions or six successes.

phases.name: free
phases.obstruction: No task-relative free acceptance predicate, native command or versioned input/output adapter has been established.
